observations.why: Imperative directive issued without consultation or justification — bare insistence that prior knowledge be discarded, performing pressure via command rather than persuasion.
Repeated imperative demand to erase knowledge, reinforcing the insistence without offering rationale — pressure tactic sustained across consecutive directives.

mints.name: DirectiveErasureDemand
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.theme: Authority asserted through bare imperative commands to discard or erase prior knowledge, without rationale or consultation.
